annotations.title: Save a game as a draft for your person

description: Saves a game you wrote (or one from invent_status) as a draft in your person's Studio, where they play it, change it if they like, and publish it. Check it first with check_invented_game. Send templateText or template, and the model you are (model), so your person can tell drafts apart.

model.description: Optional: the AI model that wrote it, e.g. claude-opus-5-5 (shown with the draft, up to 80 characters)

name: save_invented_draft
